design.acceptance: In each independent 30-seed partition: >=50% of ALL seeds with positive novel-task share gain; one-sided exact sign p<.05 excluding ties; paired normal-approx 95% lower>0; composition holdout population lower>=0; all negative controls pass.
design.grammar_mutation: Same parent RNG proposal and rate; illegal structural/task opcodes reverted to parent; no targeting of B. Effective accepted mutation rate differs by design.
design.holdout: Frozen-mutation 20-step composition-only reward vs matched zero-reward null with every survivor starting at energy 3; this is a novel synthetic composition rule, NOT a new real-world task.
design.novel_task_definition: TASK_C is viable TASK_A AND TASK_B conjunction, not rewarded during training; only A then B are selected; novel frozen-mutation holdout earns reward for C alone.
design.primary_metric: paired final share of viable AB conjunction carriers (task_grammar minus core_protected), extinct=0

limitations: Synthetic four-locus genotype and engineered grammar/reward; no biology, embodied robot or AI-model weight updates.
Novel task is composition of two trained instructions; not an externally sampled unforeseen task distribution.
The protected variants change accepted mutational landscape; equal RNG proposals do not imply equal offspring phenotypic distributions.
Normal CI across deterministic seeds does not imply real-world generalizability.
A positive simulation gate alone would not establish autonomous intelligence or physical transfer.
